The actors use a sophisticated multi-stage attack chain exploiting CVEs in VPN and hypervisor systems (CVE-2024-40766, CVE-2023-27532, CVE-2024-40711), employing dual ransomware variants (Akira and Megazord) and a double-extortion model to encrypt victim systems and exfiltrate data worth approximately $244.17 million USD as of late September 2025. Their tactics span initial access through credential theft and vulnerability exploitation, to lateral movement using legitimate tools (AnyDesk, RDP, SSH), privilege escalation via credential dumping and BYOVD techniques, and data exfiltration via cloud services and Tor-based communications.
